const saved = [];
async function save(item) {
	saved.push(item);
}
async function main() {
	const groups = [
		[1, 2],
		[3, 4],
	];
	for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
		for (const item of groups[i]) {
			await save(item);
		}
		if (saved.length > 10) break;
	}
	if (saved.join(",") !== "1,2,3,4") throw Error(String(saved));
	console.log(JSON.stringify({ saved }));
}
main();
